notes: GameDevelopmentBot V0.26: fixes for the Open existing project and How to prompt buttons (they could show SyntaxError lines when an older GameDevelopmentBot was still running in the background after an update - the app and Setup now replace that old background copy). Each new chat now starts its own game: a game idea typed in a new chat (for example "a fantasy RPG where...") starts the new-game questions and builds its own genre, instead of reusing the game from another chat. Free trial: the one-project limit is shown right away instead of after the questions.
